subject: First Fridays Words and Music
overview: The West Medford Community Center hosted its First Fridays Words and Music event featuring a panel discussion with representatives from the Mystic River Watershed Association followed by an a cappella performance by vocalist Donna McElroy.

items.title: Poetry Reading and Opening Remarks
items.summary: Terry Carter opened the program with introductory remarks and a recitation of his poem, "A River Runs Through It."

items.title: Mystic River Watershed Association Panel Discussion
items.summary: Representatives from the Mystic River Watershed Association discussed river herring migration, urban heat mitigation, tree equity, and community engagement efforts across local municipalities.

items.title: Community Center Announcements
items.summary: Terry Carter outlined upcoming West Medford Community Center programs, senior services, and summer community events.

items.title: Musical Performance by Donna McElroy
items.summary: Vocalist Donna McElroy performed a set of gospel hymns, spirituals, and jazz selections accompanied by personal stories and reflections.
